commands.name: documents.list
commands.description: List the documents in the Draft editor, e.g. "what documents do I have".

commands.name: document.active
commands.description: Say which document is open in the Draft editor, e.g. "which document am I working on".

commands.name: document.open
commands.description: Open a document in the Draft editor by name, e.g. "open my budget document".

commands.name: text.read
commands.description: Read the text of the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "read my document to me". A long document comes in parts: when truncated is true, call again with from set to next.

from.description: Start position, to read only part. Leave out to start at the beginning

to.description: End position, to read only part. Leave out to read to the end

commands.name: outline.read
commands.description: List the headings of the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "what are the sections of this document".

commands.name: text.find
commands.description: Find words in the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "where does this document mention the budget".

caseSensitive.description: True to match capital letters exactly. Leave out to ignore case

commands.name: text.replace
commands.description: Replace words in the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "change Tuesday to Wednesday in my document". The person may need to accept the change first.

replace.description: The new words. Empty text deletes the words

occurrence.description: Which match to change, counting from 1. Needed when the words appear more than once

caseSensitive.description: True to match capital letters exactly. Leave out to ignore case

commands.name: text.insert
commands.description: Insert text into the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "add a sentence at the end".

at.description: Where to insert. Leave out to add at the end

commands.name: format.mark
commands.description: Make text bold, italic, underlined, struck through, code, superscript, subscript or highlighted in the Draft editor, e.g. "make the title bold".

from.description: Start position. Leave out to use the current selection

to.description: End position. Leave out to use the current selection

commands.name: format.style
commands.description: Set the paragraph style in the Draft editor: body, title, subtitle or a heading level, e.g. "make this a heading".

from.description: Start position. Leave out to use the current selection

to.description: End position. Leave out to use the current selection

commands.name: format.align
commands.description: Align paragraphs left, centre, right or justified in the Draft editor, e.g. "centre the title".

from.description: Start position. Leave out to use the current selection

to.description: End position. Leave out to use the current selection

commands.name: format.link
commands.description: Add, change or remove a link on text in the Draft editor, e.g. "link this to the report".

from.description: Start position. Leave out to use the current selection

to.description: End position. Leave out to use the current selection

href.description: The web address. Empty text removes the link

commands.name: format.list
commands.description: Turn paragraphs into a bulleted or numbered list in the Draft editor, or back, e.g. "make these a numbered list".

from.description: Start position. Leave out to use the current selection

to.description: End position. Leave out to use the current selection

commands.name: footnote.insert
commands.description: Add a footnote in the Draft editor, e.g. "add a footnote citing the source".

at.description: Where the note mark goes. Leave out to add it at the end

commands.name: table.insert
commands.description: Insert a table in the Draft editor, e.g. "add a table with three columns".

header.description: True for a header row. Default true

at.description: Where to insert. Leave out to add at the end

commands.name: table.edit
commands.description: Change a table in the Draft editor: add or delete a row or column, toggle the header row, merge or split cells, or delete the table, e.g. "add a row to the table".

at.description: A position inside the table cell to act on

commands.name: image.set
commands.description: Set a picture's alt text, caption, position or width in the Draft editor, e.g. "describe the picture for screen readers".

width.description: Width as a percentage of the text column, 1 to 100. 0 for natural size

commands.name: insert.page-break
commands.description: Insert a page break in the Draft editor, e.g. "start a new page here".

at.description: Where to break. Leave out to add at the end

commands.name: insert.contents
commands.description: Insert a table of contents built from the headings in the Draft editor, e.g. "add a table of contents".

maxLevel.description: Deepest heading level listed, 1 to 6. Default 3

at.description: Where to insert. Leave out to add at the end

commands.name: history.undo
commands.description: Undo the last change in the Draft editor, e.g. "undo that".

commands.name: history.redo
commands.description: Redo the change just undone in the Draft editor, e.g. "redo that".

commands.name: comments.list
commands.description: List the comments in the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "what comments are there".

commands.name: comment.add
commands.description: Add a comment on some text in the Draft editor, e.g. "comment that this figure needs a source".

from.description: Start of the text to comment on

to.description: End of the text to comment on

commands.name: comment.reply
commands.description: Reply to a comment in the Draft editor, e.g. "reply that the source is added".

commands.name: comment.resolve
commands.description: Resolve or reopen a comment in the Draft editor, e.g. "mark that comment as done".

commands.name: comment.delete
commands.description: Delete a comment in the Draft editor, e.g. "remove that comment".

commands.name: changes.list
commands.description: List the suggested changes (tracked changes) in the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "what changes are suggested".

commands.name: change.accept
commands.description: Accept one suggested change, or all of them, in the Draft editor, e.g. "accept all the changes".

commands.name: change.reject
commands.description: Reject one suggested change, or all of them, in the Draft editor, e.g. "reject that change".

commands.name: suggesting.set
commands.description: Turn suggesting mode (track changes) on or off in the Draft editor, e.g. "track my changes".

on.description: True to track edits as suggestions

commands.name: page.read
commands.description: Read the page setup of the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "what paper size is this".

commands.name: page.set
commands.description: Change the page setup in the Draft editor: paper size, orientation, margins, header, footer, page numbers, e.g. "use landscape pages".

margins.description: Top, right, bottom, left in millimetres

differentFirst.description: True for no header, footer or number on the first page

commands.name: document.print
commands.description: Print the open document, or save it as PDF, from the Draft editor, e.g. "print this".

commands.name: document.export
commands.description: Export the open document from the Draft editor as Markdown, HTML, Draft JSON or Word, e.g. "give me this as markdown".

kind.description: The format. Word comes back as base64

history.description: Draft JSON only: true to include saved versions and hidden comments. Default false

commands.name: document.new
commands.description: Start a new document in the Draft editor, blank or from a template, e.g. "start a new letter".

name.description: Document name. Leave out for untitled

template.description: Template id from templates.list, e.g. letter

commands.name: document.delete
commands.description: Delete a document in the Draft editor permanently, e.g. "delete my old draft".

commands.name: templates.list
commands.description: List the document templates in the Draft editor, e.g. "what templates are there".

commands.name: template.save
commands.description: Save the open document as a template in the Draft editor, e.g. "save this as a template called report".

commands.name: assistant.check
commands.description: Check the open document for spelling, grammar, style and accessibility issues in the Draft editor, e.g. "proofread my document".

commands.name: assistant.apply
commands.description: Apply a fix the writing assistant found in the Draft editor, e.g. "fix that spelling".

replacement.description: Which suggested replacement to use. Leave out for the first

commands.name: panel.open
commands.description: Open a panel in the Draft editor: documents, find, settings, writing help, format, insert, review, page setup, assistant, versions, the command palette or help, e.g. "open the comments".

commands.name: version.save
commands.description: Save a named version of the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "save a version called first draft".

name.description: Version name. Leave out for a dated name

commands.name: versions.list
commands.description: List the saved versions of the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "what versions are saved".

commands.name: version.restore
commands.description: Restore a saved version in the Draft editor; the current text is saved as a version first, e.g. "go back to the first draft".

commands.name: version.delete
commands.description: Delete a saved version in the Draft editor, e.g. "delete the old version".

commands.name: compare.version
commands.description: Compare the open document with a saved version in the Draft editor, e.g. "what changed since the first draft".

commands.name: compare.document
commands.description: Compare the open document with another document in the Draft editor, e.g. "compare this with the old report".

commands.name: compare.as-suggestions
commands.description: Show the difference from a saved version or another document as suggested changes in the Draft editor, e.g. "show the changes as track changes".

commands.name: sidecar.preset
commands.description: Propose a shorter, longer, more formal or plain-English rewrite of a passage in the Draft editor; the person accepts it, e.g. "make this paragraph shorter".

from.description: Start of the passage. Leave out for the selection

commands.name: sidecar.translate
commands.description: Propose a translation of a passage in the Draft editor; the person accepts it, e.g. "translate this into Hindi".

target.description: Target language code, e.g. hi, fr

insertBelow.description: True to add the translation below instead of replacing

from.description: Start of the passage. Leave out for the selection

commands.name: goal.set
commands.description: Set a word-count goal for the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "set a goal of 2000 words".

words.description: The goal in words. 0 clears it

commands.name: goal.read
commands.description: Read the word-count goal of the open document in the Draft editor, e.g. "how close am I to my word goal".

commands.name: format.spacing
commands.description: Set line spacing, space before and after, or the first-line indent in the Draft editor, for the selection or the whole document, e.g. "double-space the document".

scope.description: The selected paragraphs, or the document default

commands.name: format.text
commands.description: Set the text colour or size in the Draft editor, e.g. "make this red".

commands.name: format.direction
commands.description: Set paragraphs to left-to-right, right-to-left or automatic in the Draft editor, e.g. "this paragraph is Arabic, make it right to left".

commands.name: list.style
commands.description: Change a numbered list's style or restart its numbering in the Draft editor, e.g. "number this list with roman numerals".

restart.description: True to restart at 1, false to continue the previous list

commands.name: symbol.insert
commands.description: Insert a special character in the Draft editor, e.g. "insert the rupee sign".

at.description: A document position. Leave out for the end or the selection

commands.name: table.cell
commands.description: Shade table cells or show or hide their borders in the Draft editor, e.g. "shade the header row grey".

scope.description: The cell at the position, or the whole table

at.description: A position inside the table cell

commands.name: endnote.insert
commands.description: Add an endnote in the Draft editor, e.g. "add an endnote with the source".

at.description: A document position. Leave out for the end or the selection

commands.name: xref.insert
commands.description: Insert a cross-reference to a heading in the Draft editor, e.g. "refer to the methods section here".

target.description: The heading's bookmark id, from bookmarks.list

at.description: A document position. Leave out for the end or the selection

commands.name: bookmarks.list
commands.description: List the headings that cross-references can point to in the Draft editor, e.g. "what sections can I refer to".

commands.name: page.preview
commands.description: Open the print preview with real page breaks in the Draft editor, e.g. "show me the pages".

commands.name: page.guide
commands.description: Show or hide the approximate page guide while writing in the Draft editor, e.g. "show where the pages break".

commands.name: equation.insert
commands.description: Insert an equation written in LaTeX in the Draft editor, e.g. "add the equation E = mc^2".

display.description: True for a display equation on its own line

at.description: A document position. Leave out for the end or the selection

commands.name: equation.set
commands.description: Change an equation's LaTeX in the Draft editor, e.g. "fix the exponent in that equation".

commands.name: citations.import
commands.description: Import references from BibTeX or CSL-JSON text into the document's library in the Draft editor, e.g. "add these references".

commands.name: citation.insert
commands.description: Cite one or more references from the library in the Draft editor, e.g. "cite Doe 2020 here".

locator.description: A page or section, e.g. p. 4

at.description: A document position. Leave out for the end or the selection

commands.name: bibliography.insert
commands.description: Insert a bibliography of the cited works in the Draft editor, e.g. "add the references list".

at.description: A document position. Leave out for the end or the selection

commands.name: citations.style
commands.description: Set the citation style in the Draft editor: APA, Chicago author-date, IEEE or Harvard, e.g. "use IEEE citations".

commands.name: citations.list
commands.description: List the references in the document's library and where they are cited in the Draft editor, e.g. "what references do I have".

commands.name: assistant.languagetool
commands.description: Turn on LanguageTool grammar checking through a server running on this computer, or turn it off, in the Draft editor, e.g. "use my LanguageTool server".

url.description: The server address on 127.0.0.1, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8081. Empty turns it off

commands.name: assistant.languagetool-test
commands.description: Test the connection to a LanguageTool server on this computer from the Draft editor; sends no document text, e.g. "is LanguageTool running".

url.description: The server address. Leave out for the saved one

commands.name: assistant.vale-read
commands.description: Read the Vale house-style settings and rules in the Draft editor, e.g. "what style rules do I have".

commands.name: assistant.vale-set
commands.description: Turn Vale house-style checking on or off, or add, change or remove a rule file, in the Draft editor, e.g. "add a rule against the word utilise".

path.description: A rule file path, e.g. styles/House/Words.yml

remove.description: True to delete the rule file at path
